title: Crew Of Lancaster Ll811 Bq J And Their Comrades
memorial_details:
description: PLAQUE ON SHIELD: ON JUNE 6TH 1944 THE GREATEST LIBERATING ARMADA EVER ASSEMBLED/ LEFT THE SHORES OF ENGLAND. FOR BOMBER COMMAND THE INVASION OF/ OCCUPIED EUROPE COMMENCED THE NIGHT BEFORE. AT 23.34 HOURS/ LANCASTER LL811, SQUADRON MARKINGS BQ-J WAS THE FIRST AIRCRAFT/ IN THE FIRST WAVE TO STRIKE AHEAD OF THE MAIN SPEARHEAD BY MANY/ HOURS, SO SETTING THE MOMENTOUS EVENTS IN MOTION./ THAT AIRCRAFT LEFT FROM 550 SQUADRON, AND THIS HISTORIC OPERATION/ PUT NORTH KILLINGHOLME ON THE MAP. FOR THE BRAVE YOUNG LADS OF/ THAT CREW, SHOWN BELOW, AND FOR ALL THEIR COMRADES WHO DID NOT/ RETURN WE DEDICATE THIS SIMPLE PLAQUE.

SHIELD: (NAMES)
